documents.title: 41St Annual General Meeting Of Antelopus Selan Energy Limited Is Schedule To Be Held On September 30, 2026 At 11Am Through Video Conferencing (VC)/ Other Audio Video Means (OVAM).
Announcement Under Reg. 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015 - Award Of Contract Area To The Company

analysis.summary: Antelopus Selan Energy Limited released its Q1 FY27 presentation detailing operational updates across Bakrol, Karjisan, Cambay, and Assam basins. Average sales for the quarter stood at 1,705 boepd alongside an EBITDA of Rs 93.2 Cr and a profit after tax of Rs 53.8 Cr. Management reiterated its guidance to reach 2,500 boepd in FY27 as frac impacts materialize from Q2. Additionally, the company won two onshore licenses in DSF Bid Round IV and reported progress on its ongoing drilling campaigns. Antelopus Selan Energy Limited reported its FY26 annual results, highlighting volume-driven growth with average sales increasing to 1,355 boepd and an exit rate of over 1,800 boepd.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the guidance of reaching 2,500 boepd in FY27 remains intact.
guidance.quote: Our guidance of reaching 2,500 boepdin FY’27 remains intact, as impact from Frac will be seen from Q2 onwards

guidance.claim: The company is starting FY27 with a base of over 1,800 boepd and has a roadmap to exceed 2,500 boepd.
guidance.quote: We begin our FY 27 with a base of 1800+ boepd with a road map to 2500+ boepd in FY ‘27

guidance.claim: The company plans to drill a second new well for Cambay in the second half of FY27.
guidance.quote: Second new well is planned for Cambay in H2 FY’27, to build further on the ramp-up momentum

guidance.claim: Drilling for the remaining 8 wells at Bakrol is scheduled to be completed in the first half of CY2026.
guidance.quote: Remaining 8 wells drilling to complete in H1 CY2026; full ramp-up to follow through mid-year

demand_outlook.claim: The company achieved volume-driven growth despite facing a challenging pricing environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Volume-driven growth despite a challenging pricing environment

capex_expansion.claim: Drilling at Karjisan is planned to commence by the end of FY27.
One new well in Cambay is planned in H2 FY27 to target either the Western or Central area of the block.
The company won 2 highly contested onshore licenses in DSF Bid Round IV.
A second new well is planned for Cambay in the second half of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Second new well is planned for Cambay in H2 FY’27, to build further on the ramp-up momentum

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning additional facilities and tankage for incremental oil and gas at Bakrol and Karjisan.
capex_expansion.quote: Additional facilities & tankage for incremental oil & gas at Bakrol and Karjisan

margins_costs.claim: The company recorded an EBITDA of Rs 167.5 crore with a 59% margin and a Profit After Tax of INR 89.6 crore.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA Rs 167.5 Cr. (c. +14%) & EBITDA margin at 59% ; Profit After Tax at INR 89.6Cr,up(c.+27%);

margins_costs.claim: Incremental revenue flowed directly to EBITDA as year-on-year expenses remained constant.
margins_costs.quote: Incremental revenue — a clean EBITDA flow-through as y-o-y expenses remainedconstant

margins_costs.claim: The company experienced strong quarter-on-quarter EBITDA growth despite low oil and gas prices.
margins_costs.quote: Strong Q-o-Q Volume driven growth (c.35%) coupled with strong EBITDA growth

orders_capacity.claim: Average sales for Q1 FY27 were 1,705 boepd compared to 1,758 boepd in Q4 FY26.
Bakrol registered total sales of 701 boepd in Q1 FY27.
Karjisan recorded total sales of 834 boepd in Q1 FY27.
Gross sales for the Cambay field were 130 boepd in Q1 FY27.
At Karjisan, 4 new wells were drilled, and average sales surged by approximately 48% to 684 boepd.
Cambay's gross sales in March 2026 exceeded 200 boepd, driven by production in the Western flank.
orders_capacity.quote: Cambay’s Mar’26 gross sales exceeded 200 boepd—primarily driven by production in Western flank

orders_capacity.claim: At Bakrol, 2 out of 10 wells contributed to FY26 sales from the end of February 2026, with a third well online in mid-April 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: 2 of 10 wells contributed to FY’26 sales from end Feb ’26. 3rd well bought online in midApril’26

orders_capacity.claim: Bakrol sales increased significantly from two wells, with Q4 FY26 averaging approximately 596 boepd.
orders_capacity.quote: Bakrol sales increased significantlyfrom these 2 wells –with Q4 FY’26 averaging at c.596 boepd

orders_capacity.claim: The Dangeru field commenced production in August 2025, adding a new producing asset to the portfolio.
orders_capacity.quote: Field commenced production from August 2025, adding a new producing asset to the portfolio

orders_capacity.claim: Average sales for the quarter were approximately 1500 boepd.
orders_capacity.quote: Average sales for the Quarter @ c.1500 boepd

capital_allocation.claim: Commissioner (Appeals) allowed the company's refund claim for excess Cess paid in FY21-FY23 of c. 6.56 Cr.
capital_allocation.quote: Commissioner (Appeals) allowed the Company's refund claim for excess Cess paid in FY21–FY23, of c. ₹6.56 Cr. whichwasearlierexpense. Toberecognizeduponreceiptoffinalorder

risks_headwinds.claim: Custody transfer to IOCL ran for only ~86-87 days this quarter, resulting in a crude inventory build-up.
risks_headwinds.quote: Custody transfer to IOCL ran for only ~86–87 days this quarter, and resulted in a build-up of c. 6,500 bopd of crude inventory during the Quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company experienced a challenging pricing environment during the period.
risks_headwinds.quote: Volume-driven growth despite a challenging pricing environment

risks_headwinds.claim: The Dangeru field is facing evacuation constraints that are currently being debottlenecked.
risks_headwinds.quote: Ramp up being planned from existing well. Evacuation constraints being debottlenecked

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that continuous frac campaign is set to commence early August with full productivity expected in Q2.
Drilling at Karjisan is scheduled to commence by the end of FY27.
One new well in Cambay is planned in H2 FY27.
The next phase of activities includes a well planned for H2 FY27 in the Cambay field.
management_commitments.quote: The next well is planned for H2 FY'27, targeting the deeper Eocene reservoir in the Western/Central part of the block.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to drill a second new well for Cambay in the second half of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Second new well is planned for Cambay in H2 FY’27, to build further on the ramp-up momentum
